profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Oracle
profile.summary:
Accounts Receivables Expert for Opera PMS application. 
Technical Lead for the Performance Tuning Team. Leading my team we were able to succesfully improve the overall time for Opera Mega Patches upgrade in the data centers by 60%.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: OPERA 5 Development - HGBU OGTS (Opera Global Technical Services)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: OPERA 5 Development - HGBU OGTS (Opera Global Technical Services)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Improved the stability across all Opera versions including Opera Cloud and Opera 5. Bug fixing (database related code, forms and reports, servlets).  Continued Software Development for Opera PMS including Opera Exchange Interfaces (OXI).   Servlet related changes in JDeveloper 11 and 12c.  Developments is Oracle Forms - Reports 11g. Oracle Database 11g, 10g R2.
Technical design documents contributor for new projects for major accounts like Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Hyatt.  Assistance to software developers, technical analysts, and L3 members in troubleshooting cases.  Involved as a developer in different stages in the SDLC for the Opera product.

positions.title: Lead Developer Sustaining Engineering
positions.description: Leading role in Sustaining Engineering (SE). Contributor for the SE strategic plan .  Some of my responsibilities included: Sprint Planning.  Coordinating and delegating tasks for my team of developers.  Discussed the challenges for the assigments and provided technical assistance, guidance and guidelines for SQL and PLSQL coding.  Improvements to the Financial Analysis Tool.  Reprioritized tasks based on commitments made with internal and external customers.  Satisfied software deliverables accross all Opera versions.  Received escalations from Triage team during regular and after hours.  Support for critical areas in the Hotel Business Unit for the Opera Application.  Leading the Performance Tuning team to improve performance across diferent modules of the Opera Application.  Provided assistance to Triage, Smoke and QA teams and troubleshoot critical cases until the solution is implemented.  Provide risk analysis for new implementations.  Assistance in the code review process through different areas of the application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Development for the Opera Hotel application system in the following modules: AR, Billing, Rates and Night Audit, End of Day, OVOS modules. Developments in Oracle 10gR2 Database and Oracle Application Suite 10g Suite R2 under Windows platform.  Software Development and application support. Developments to support Legal Country requirements for different countries: Qatar, Turkey, Portugal, Poland, Venezuela, Argentina, Kenya, Venezuela. 
Application tuning and Performance enhancement.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Consulting services for Web development and System Analysis.  Different tasks included:
Develop the strategic plan to implement a communication platform so the company were able to publish and broadcast their content through the web.  
Gathered business requirements and provided software analysis to enhance custom application modules.
Elaborated design document and developed functionality using packages, triggers and routines in the back-end (oracle 10g R2) to support business functions.
Involved in configuring scripts in unix so that the functionality in the web pages were able to work with custom code added to the web scripts.
Configured an e-commerce solution to sell products from the internet through the web page and other sources.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Administration, Development, Support and maintenance tasks for the Oracle Financial (eBusiness Suite 11.3 and 11.5.10.2) applications (Oracle Forms and Reports, sql/plsq, backend packages), including: AR, AP, GL modules and enhancements to the  customized Cash Management Module.  
Involved in importing invoices from third party system into Oracle Receivables using SQL*Loader, Custom Store Procedures, PL/SQL validations and the Auto Invoice Interface Program. 
Request sets configuration.
Developed new reports.  Worked in forms tuning. 
Created and maintained End User Layer, Business Areas and Workbooks using Discoverer Administrator and Noetix Views Administrator.  Trained users on how to produce ad-hoc reports using Discoverer Desktop. 
Involved in the change management and version control for scripts and custom code related to oracle financials. 
Enhanced the ODCS (Optio Document Customization Server) to produced pdf reports from EBS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Development for the Opera Hotel application system including the Analysis, Design, Development and  Support for the Financial area in the following modules: Cashiering, Audit  and Accounts Receivables. Performance Tuning of the application including not only the re-design of expensive and complex queries and reports but to analyze an optimal way of coding that uses the different oracle engines with the most efficient approach for optimal transactions response. Developments in Oracle Developer Suite 10g. SQL and PL/SQL code and scripts on Oracle 10g database.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Implementation of the Accounts Receivable Module for the SIAD System.  PL/SQL scripts and store procedures for the Accounts Recovery Module, in Oracle 9i.  Application testing and user training.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Project with Pagos Internacionales – Analysis and implementation of the Information System for foreign currency and funds transfers. Analysis, Design and Implementation of the Security Clearance System. Design, and develop the Accounts Receivable Module.  Developments in Forms 6i, Reports 6i, Database Triggers, Scripts in PL/SQL - Functions, Store Procedures, Oracle Data Base 9i administration with TOAD Xpert, Tuning PL/SQL Statements. Experience with Windows 2000 Advanced Server.

positions.title: Sofware Developer
positions.description:
Developments in Forms and Reports 6i, Oracle 9i. Support, development and implementation of forms and reports for the Financial System, modules: accounting, budget, collections, petty cash, treasurer, accounts payable,  physical resources (inventories and purchases), investments, funds and money market accounts.  Migration of the Financial system from Reports 2.5 to 6i and Forms 4.5 to 6i.
Development in PL/SQL, queries and reports for the Telephone Billing System  of Cali – Colombia, for the ERT. Oracle Data Base 8i with Unix Operating system.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Development of Websites, in Microsoft Front Page 2000 and Macromedia Dream Weaver, for the Woman Image Corporation. Support and training in Microsoft tools, Corel Draw and Adobe Photoshop

positions.title: Sofware Developer
positions.description: Analysis, development and implementation of the Information System of the Clinic Laboratory, in Oracle Forms 4.5 and Reports 2.5.  Oracle Data Base 7x with Windows NT Operating System.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Contract for one year with the Varela S.A. Company. Giving support to the sales and orders department. Developments in SQL, Forms 3.0, PL/SQL. Course in Forms 4.5.  Oracle Data Base with HP-UX Operating system.

certifications.name: Oracle Autonomous Database Cloud 2019 Certified Specialist
certifications.title: Oracle Autonomous Database Cloud 2019 Certified Specialist

courses.name: Database Performance and Tuning 11g Best Practices
